newsitem.title: GERMANY: Polish interest in German rapeseed seen lasting.
newsitem.headline: Polish interest in German rapeseed seen lasting.

text.p: Poland may have bought some 200,000 tonnes of German rapeseed since the harvest and could be looking for another 100,000 up to next summer, brokers said on Thursday.
"Most sales will have been made and are being transported at the moment, but there is a steady trickle of new business, which underpins the domestic rapeseed price," one broker said.
Germany's central farm price office ZMP in a weekly report also noted that Polish buyers of old crop seed had reappeared.
Most contracts were already fixed in September and October.
Poland's own 1996 rapeseed output was 438,000 tonnes, down from 1.38 million last year, the Warsaw agriculture ministry said earlier this month.
Imports will be duty-free until June 1997.
Germany's crop was also sharply down at 1.95 million tonnes this year compared with 3.11 million in 1995.
Dec/Jan rapeseed buyers free Polish border were in a 470-500 marks cif range, with local northern German prices at 465-470, sources said. --Vera Eckert, Hamburg newsroom +49-40-41903275
